test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Anurag said, “The coming elections in Bihar will be the main topic of discussion for the next fortnight.”

options.text: Anurag predicted that the coming elections in Bihar would be the main topic of discussion for the following fortnight.
Anurag informed that the coming elections in Bihar were the main topic of discussion for the following fortnight.
Anurag commented that the coming elections in Bihar will be the main topic of discussion for the next fortnight.
Anurag exclaimed that the coming elections in Bihar are the main topic of discussion for the coming fortnight.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__ **Anurag predicted that the coming elections in Bihar would be the main topic of discussion for the following fortnight.**__
